title: Sorting network on 18 inputs with the fewest comparators
statement: Find a sorting network on 18 channels (a fixed sequence of comparators, each putting the smaller of two values on the lower-numbered channel, that sorts every input) with as few comparators as possible. The smallest known network on Bert Dobbelaere's list has 77 comparators; a network with fewer comparators improves it. Its depth is reported but not scored.
submission: Text file: the comparators in order, each as a pair of channel numbers 0..17; every two integers form one comparator (Dobbelaere's "[(0,13),(1,12),...]" format and one "i j" per line both work; text after # is ignored).
score: the number of comparators (smaller is better)

best_known.source: size 77 for 18 inputs: Bert Dobbelaere's list of sorting networks (bertdobbelaere.github.io/sorting_networks_extended.html), which credits each network; read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: B. Dobbelaere, Smallest and fastest sorting networks
